company.name: Palifer
company.shortDescription: Palifer provides users with immediate answers to their healthcare concerns through artificial intelligence.
company.description:
Sick people look for medical information online to figure out if they have the sickness that they’re worrying about, not to learn about the intricacies of their disease. Palifer provides users with immediate answers to their healthcare concerns through AI.

We ask users the question: "Do I have <insert sickness>?" and use machine learning on additional information to confirm or deny their sickness worries. We reassure users that they do not have what they assumed; otherwise, we guide them to treatment. Our services are similar to WebMD and Mayo Clinic information; however, Palifer ask users questions through a web interface to provide them with more accurate and tailored results.
